code='''def transform(grid):
    # Apply the demonstrated vertical rearrangement to each colored component.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                comps.append((min(y for y,x in cells), col, cells))
    for top,col,cells in comps:
        dr = 6 if top <= 2 else -2 if top >= 5 else 0
        for y,x in cells:
            yy=y+dr
            if 0<=yy<h: out[yy][x]=col
    return out
